Is the law of attraction a scam, or is something missing?

Kevin Trudeau says many people try the law of attraction and don't get the results they want. That is why some call it a scam.

He sees it differently. In his words, the mind does create what you want, but the recipe has missing ingredients, and without them the results don't show up.

Which do you think gets left out most often, belief or method?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

What if the world outside is just a mirror?

Kevin Trudeau quotes an old idea: as within, so without. In his view, the world you see reflects the thoughts you carry inside.

He says your ability to control your thoughts shapes your success, and that training the mind is something he believes wealthy people have in common.

What is your mind showing you right now?
